entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yes, hi. I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. Order number is VF-789012.

Okay, thank you. Let me pull up that order. VF-789012... I see it here for a VeloBand Pulse. It looks like it was delivered 15 days ago. And I see you're one of our VIP members, so thank you for your loyalty.
Great. So how do I send it back? I have the box and everything.

I understand you'd like to return it, but I'm showing that the VeloBand Pulse has a specific 10-day return window due to the nature of the electronic components. Since it was delivered 15 days ago, we are unfortunately outside that period.

Are you kidding me? Ten days? Look, this has been a complete mess. The VeloBand **was a gift** for my spouse, who then ended up in the **hospital** for a few days—nothing serious, thank goodness, but it completely derailed our plans.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope your spouse is recovering well.

He is, but that's not the point. Right after that, I was **traveling** for business. I finally got a moment to handle this yesterday and your **website crashed** on me three times while I was trying to initiate the return. That's when I finally found the policy, buried in the **fine print**. It’s an impossible window.

I can certainly understand your frustration. It sounds like you've had a very challenging couple of weeks, and I apologize for the trouble with the website. While the 10-day policy is firm, I do want to find a way to make this right for you, especially as you're a VIP customer.
Good. I want a full refund. This thing is still in the box.
I can't override the system to provide a full cash refund, but given the circumstances you've described, I can offer you a VeloFit store credit. How about a $25 credit for the trouble?
Twenty-five dollars? That's an insult. The band cost $150. That's not a solution. I'm really losing my patience here.

You're right. My apologies, that was not an appropriate starting point. Your frustration is valid. Let me review your account again... Because you're a long-time VIP member and you experienced a technical issue with our site, I can do significantly better. I can authorize a $100 store credit to your account right now.
A hundred dollars? So I don't need to send the band back?

That's correct. You can keep the VeloBand Pulse, and the $100 credit will be available immediately for you to use on any other gear. It's the maximum I'm authorized to offer, and I think it's fair given the situation.
Wow. Okay. That... that actually works. I can use that for a new jersey. I was about to swear off VeloFit for good, but this helps. Thank you.

I'm so glad to hear that. We never want to lose a valued customer like you. I've just applied that $100 credit. You should see it in your VeloFit account now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. I really appreciate you working with me on this. You've been very helpful.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for your patience, and have a great rest of your day.
